c-integration-abilities-api.1.evidence: admin GET /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/abilities (WP 7.1.3, 63 abilities total) lists 19 jetonomy/* (create-post, get-post, list-posts, create-reply, list-replies, vote, list-spaces, get-space, join-space, list-space-members, create-space, get-user-profile, list-notifications, mark-notifications-read, get-activity, flag-content, moderate-content, list-flags, search) and 12 jetonomy-pro/*.

c-integration-abilities-api.2.evidence: bob ran jetonomy/create-post into Feature Requests -> 200 {id:6149,title,is_private:false,url}, topic opened at /community/s/feature-requests/t/can-the-leaderboard-be-filtered-by-space/. The result is a short {id,title,is_private,url}, not the full object POST /spaces/{id}/posts returns. Topic deleted afterwards.

c-integration-abilities-api.3.evidence: jetonomy/create-reply on 6149 -> 200 {id:13663,post_id:6149}; jetonomy/vote value 1 -> 200 {vote_score:1,user_vote:1}. Note: both were on bob's own topic and the vote was accepted; the same self-vote went through on bob's topic 5835 (score 7 -> 8, taken back via REST). Neither the ability nor POST /posts/{id}/vote refuses voting on your own topic.

c-integration-abilities-api.4.evidence: bob jetonomy/search query 'dark mode' limit 10 returns post ids 5709, 5633, 5700, 5874, 5757, 5732; GET /search?q=dark mode&limit=10 returns the same six ids in the same order.

c-integration-abilities-api.5.expected: alice flags bob's reply once; a repeat returns a jetonomy_ prefixed error
c-integration-abilities-api.5.actual: every jetonomy/flag-content call returns 500 jetonomy_flag_failed 'Failed to create flag.' (reply and topic, reasons spam, inappropriate, off-topic), so no flag is ever created. execute_flag_content passes user_id and details to Flag::create, which takes reporter_id and description, and offers reasons inappropriate and off-topic that the flags table enum (offensive, off_topic, harassment) does not have. The ability also performs none of the REST route's checks (own content, already reported, readable space).

c-integration-abilities-api.6.evidence: test_moderator: jetonomy/list-flags status=pending -> 200 with flag rows (reporter shown as user_id 0); jetonomy/moderate-content via DELETE (destructive annotation needs DELETE) action=trash on reply 13663 -> 200 {success:true,new_status:trash}. He is a WordPress Editor, so moderates every space.

c-integration-abilities-api.7.evidence: logged out jetonomy/create-post (no nonce) -> 401 rest_ability_cannot_execute, no topic created. With a stale/empty nonce header the answer is 403 rest_cookie_invalid_nonce.

c-integration-abilities-api.8.expected: bob runs moderate-content and list-flags -> 403 jetonomy_forbidden
c-integration-abilities-api.8.actual: bob is refused, but the code is rest_ability_cannot_execute ('Sorry, you are not allowed to execute this ability.', 403) for both; moderate-content sent as POST answers 405 rest_ability_invalid_method (destructive abilities need DELETE). Nothing is changed.

c-integration-abilities-api.9.expected: finn runs create-post and vote -> 403 jetonomy_user_silenced
c-integration-abilities-api.9.actual: both refused with 403 rest_ability_cannot_execute, the generic permission message, not jetonomy_user_silenced and without telling him he is silenced (the REST route says 'Your account is currently silenced and cannot post.').

c-integration-abilities-api.10.evidence: bob jetonomy/create-reply on closed topic 5875 -> 403 jetonomy_post_closed 'This topic is closed and cannot receive new replies.'; test_moderator succeeded (200, reply 13664, deleted afterwards).

c-integration-abilities-api.11.evidence: bob jetonomy/create-post into archived 2025 Hackathon (36) -> 403 jetonomy_space_restricted 'This space is archived or locked and no longer accepts new content.'

c-integration-abilities-api.12.expected: get-space and list-posts for Customer Advisory Board as bob -> 404 as for a missing space
c-integration-abilities-api.12.actual: both answer 403 rest_ability_cannot_execute, and a nonexistent space 999999 answers the identical 403, so nothing leaks, but the status is 403 not 404.

c-integration-abilities-api.13.expected: join-space on Partner Program (open) joins and Insiders / Beta (approval) creates a pending request
c-integration-abilities-api.13.actual: Partner Program is private with approval to join (not open): lucia's join-space -> 200 {status:pending_approval} for both Partner Program and Insiders / Beta; the open Feature Requests space -> {status:joined}. Behaviour is right, the check names the wrong space. Requests, notifications and the Feature Requests membership were removed afterwards.

c-integration-abilities-api.15.needs: a space with 2000 topics (scale site); not on forums.local
